metadata.title: Why Tesla’s stock may have a good day on SpaceX’s coattails - MarketWatch

content.text:
2 days ago
Why Tesla’s stock may have a good day on SpaceX’s coattails
SpaceX’s public debut may end up being a plus for Elon Musk’s other public company, according to analysts.
Oppenheimer analysts led by Colin Rusch said in a Thursday note to clients that they anticipate Tesla shares will see “some support” as investors speculate about a potential merger with SpaceX. Rusch’s team, which rates Tesla at perform, don’t see a merger happening too quickly, but others think differently.
Wedbush’s Dan Ives, for one, has said for weeks that a merger is likely to occur as soon as next year, tying together Musk’s biggest companies into a single conglomerate. Tesla and SpaceX are already working together on a few things, including an expensive chipmaking project. Tesla has also sold SpaceX some $940 million worth of goods since January 2025 and has a stake in the company.
